title: Looking for playtesters for my roglike 2D game
author: Ccasual
selftext:
Hi everybody,

I wanted to make a game for so long and I started many projects but never finished them. About a year and a half ago I finally sat down made a concept and told myself that I will bring this project to a finish.

I am still a long way away but I am finally at the point where I am ready to share the game and gather some feedback about it.

The game is as 2D roguelike PC game, where you try to defend the planet against alien invaders, which come in increasingly harder and harder waves. The players job is to defend and destroy enemies, pick upgrades, map their journey and defeat the final boss.

The game is not a bullet hell or a Vampire Survivors clone, my goal is to make the combat more deliberate and precise with less but harder enemies on screen.

As a player you can rotate around the planet, shoot at enemies and block their bullets in order to keep your planet alive. If you perfectly block enemy bullets you gain bonuses which also tie in with the upgrades.

If you like roguelike games like Hades, Slay the spire and the like I would be very thankfull if you would like to playtest my game and give me some sincere feedback.

Anybody who would like to playtest the game please comment below or DM me and I will sent over the information. Thanks to everybody in advance.

PS: The game is AI code assisted, all art has been made manually.
